{
  "v": 1,
  "stage": "final",
  "look": "Depth 面板: the DSH composer at night, filling the frame, and the Depth dock rising out of the desk as one precise anodised panel — hairline rules, 8-pixel meter cells, monospaced file badges — the plugin's own slate ground, blue and mint, lit by one cool light from above. Plain.",
  "palettes": [
    ["#0F172A", "#60A5FA", "#E2E8F0", "#34D399"],
    ["#F5F3EE", "#1E3A8A", "#14161A", "#D97757"],
    ["#0B2019", "#A3E635", "#E7F0E4", "#F97362"]
  ],
  "theirs": 1,
  "width": 1920,
  "height": 1080,
  "fps": 60,
  "background": "#0F172A",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "id": "film",
      "name": "原理与效果",
      "dur": 20,
      "desc": "One continuous take: the draft lifts out of the composer and becomes the first finished turn, a hairline forks off into a read-only helper, that panel widens into the Depth dock as it runs, then folds back into the composer as the grounded prompt, and the film signs off."
    }
  ]
}
